abstract.para: Learn how to choose the right deployment image and configure it on first boot

topic.para: The image you choose determines the hypervisor you can run it on and how the system is configured on first boot. The initial configuration mechanism depends on your target environment.

listitem.para: On cloud platforms, the image is configured automatically on first boot by cloud-init. You provide your configuration instructions through the configuration file. If no cloud-init configuration is supplied, the deployment falls back to the interactive &jeosfirstboot; wizard.
Virtualization platforms (&kvm;, &vmware;, &hyperv;) do not include cloud-init and offer two configuration paths for the first boot:
Interactive (default): The &jeosfirstboot; wizard prompts you to set timezone, passwords, create a standard user, and more.

note.title: Exception for &zseries;

listitem.para: Automated: If you require an unattended, automated deployment, you can use &combustion; to bypass the &jeosfirstboot; wizard.
